text:
this is worth either a read or a reread

the first half is an article written by someone else in 2012 - this is the part worth the read

2nd half is my commentary/interpretation, you can skip it, read it, whatever, not the point

but the message itself is so important bc of what it conveys about the highs/lows of life

when ur at the highs u get all these people around you and start thinking that you’re special

when u come off the highs and the crowd thins out, u take it personal, like…wtf? I thought I was special? I thought they liked me for me?

no dude

they liked you for WHAT YOU PROVIDE. that how this world works. 

there is a very, very small group of people who like you for you. 

take whatever number you think it is, and divide it by 4 - that’s the real number. you ain’t special.

NOW…there is a benefit of this sobering reality, which u must understand if and when you find yourself at the lows.

you are to this world WHAT YOU PROVIDE.

if you’re at the lows right now, or are just feeling low, ask yourself:

what am I providing?

strong chance the answer is “not a whole lot.”

fixing that answer is how u get climb back out of the lows, both internally and externally

I’m intentionally leaving “provide” blank to allow ur imagination room to wander…it’s not just $…there are many more things u can provide to family/friends/strangers and the world at large, and they’re largely unique to your cumulative lived experience and your personality.

internally, much of ur self worth is driven by WHAT YOU PROVIDE, and as you provide more, your self-esteem and self-confidence rise in tandem

the external will follow from that, external being whatever tf it is that you seek from this world…unique to you…love, esteem, respect, wealth, admiration, idk. generally the less u seek the more u get, life is strange like that. regardless, this is the mirror image of the situation at the highs.

are you special, no. 

do most people really care about you, no.

but if you have something to share that other people find useful…are you going to find yourself with a crowd around you?

100% guaranteed

so get off ur ass and go find a way to be of service…bc that’s who you are, and that’s what you are to this world: WHAT YOU PROVIDE.
